description: This file defines a Perl module 'DiffHighlight' that provides functionality for diff highlighting in terminal output, including handling colorization, diff hunks, and line comparisons.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of the input string omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes a single line from diff input, handles graph lines, hunks, added, removed lines, and triggers output via callbacks.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes queued diff hunks for display.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads diff data from standard input and processes each line for highlighting.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration from git config or returns default.
